title: Degree-one uniqueness for conormal algebra morphisms
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion and let $G$ be its conormal graded algebra [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra]. For any sheaf $B$ of commutative $\mathcal O_Z$-algebras, two $\mathcal O_Z$-algebra maps $f,g:G\to B$ are equal if for every affine open $U\subseteq X$ they agree on the degree-one classes of all sections of the ideal-power module $\mathcal I^1$ on $U$. No Noetherian, regularity or finite generation assumption is made.

source.place: Local construction, x_i=t u_i, and the general associated-graded representative calculation, Stacks 0630, 0632 and 01LX.

proof.text: On each ambient affine chart use the presentation affineChart and powerIdentification to represent every homogeneous class by an ideal-power section. The structure-algebra condition identifies degree zero. Induct on n, using ideal-product membership induction for I^(n+1)=I^n I, to identify every degree. Additive direct-sum induction identifies the ring maps. Inverse images of ambient affine opens form a basis on the closed subscheme, so sheaf-morphism uniqueness proves equality globally.

theorem hom_ext_degree_one {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    {B : Z.CommAlgebraSheaf} (f g : (presentation i).algebra ⟶ B)
    (h : ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (a : (power i 1).val.obj (op U.1)),
      f.right.hom.app (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
          (homogeneousClass i (presentation i).algebra (presentation i).inclusion 1 U.1 a) =
        g.right.hom.app (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
          (homogeneousClass i (presentation i).algebra (presentation i).inclusion 1 U.1 a)) :
    f = g
